description: This file contains CPU detection logic for different architectures (x86_64, ARM64) including vendor identification and CPU type classification, with platform-specific code and inline assembly.

classes.name: Vendor
classes.description: Enumeration for CPU vendor types (Unknown, Intel, AMD).

methods.name: GetVendor
methods.description: Determines CPU vendor by executing CPUID with eax=0 and parsing the vendor string.

methods.name: GetIntelCpuType
methods.description: Identifies specific Intel CPU models based on CPUID leaf 1.

methods.name: GetAmdCpuType
methods.description: Identifies AMD CPU models based on CPUID leaf 1.

methods.name: GetCpuType
methods.description: Main function to get CPU type based on vendor detection.

methods.name: SupportsArmCRC32PMULL
methods.description: Checks if ARM CPU supports CRC32 with PMULL.
